people.name: Mark Zuckerberg
people.bio: Co-founder and CEO of Meta (Facebook), known for strategic long-term thinking in building one of the world's largest tech platforms.

people.name: Robert Downey Jr.
people.bio: Actor best known for portraying Iron Man, praised for his quick wit and improvisational energy on and off screen.

people.name: Benedict Cumberbatch
people.bio: Actor known for versatile, charismatic performances across a wide range of roles, from Sherlock Holmes to Doctor Strange.

people.name: Robert Pattinson
people.bio: Actor known for introspective, quietly unconventional performances, often gravitating toward artistic or offbeat roles.

people.name: Joseph Gordon-Levitt
people.bio: Actor known for creative, expressive roles and a genuine enthusiasm for exploring new ideas both on screen and off.

people.name: Warren Buffett
people.bio: Investor and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway, known for disciplined, methodical decision-making over decades.

people.name: Emma Watson
people.bio: Actress known for the Harry Potter franchise, recognized for combining a structured, driven work ethic with activism work.

people.name: Clint Eastwood
people.bio: Actor and director known for calm, hands-on, action-oriented roles and a famously understated screen presence.

people.name: Tom Hardy
people.bio: Actor known for physically intense, versatile performances across action and drama roles.

people.name: Marilyn Monroe
people.bio: Actress and cultural icon known for a vibrant, spontaneous on-screen presence that defined an era of film.

people.name: Jim Carrey
people.bio: Actor and comedian known for high-energy, spontaneous physical comedy and a larger-than-life screen presence.
